title: The Boox Palma 3 gets stylus support and a sleek redesign
summary: Boox upgraded its smartphone-sized e-reader with the Palma 3, featuring a redesigned aluminum frame and stylus support. The new model maintains the 6.13-inch E Ink screen but costs $339.99, a $60 increase from the Palma 2, launching soon.
content:
Nearly two years after the last update to Boox's smartphone-sized black-and-white e-reader, the company announced the Palma 3 with a sleek redesign, new functionality, and a handful of other small updates that may justify its significant price bump depending on how you plan to use it. While the Palma 2 launched in 2024 for $279.99, the Palma 3 will be $339.99 and is expected to be "available soon."

zh.title: Boox Palma 3 获得触笔支持和时尚重设计
zh.summary: Boox 为其智能手机尺寸的电子阅读器推出了 Palma 3，采用重新设计的铝制框架和触笔支持。新型号保留了 6.13 英寸 E Ink 屏幕，但价格为 $339.99，比 Palma 2 贵 60 美元，即将推出。

title: The EOS R8 Mark II is Canon’s lightest full-frame camera with stabilization
summary: Canon unveiled the EOS R8 Mark II with in-body image stabilization—a feature missing from the original 2023 model—and a retro design refresh. Priced at $1,899 and launching in late October, the Mark II is heavier than the original but remains lighter and cheaper than the R6 Mark III.
content:
Canon announced the second-generation of its EOS R8 with a new retro-inspired redesign and the addition of in-body stabilization. That feature was one of the most notable omissions from the original R8 that launched in 2023 as a smaller, cheaper, and more accessible alternative to the Canon R6 Mark II for photographers wanting a larger full-frame shooter. While the new EOS R8 Mark II is slightly heavier than its predecessor at 1.2 pounds thanks to the additional stabilization functionality, it's lighter and cheaper than last year's EOS R6 Mark III.

zh.title: EOS R8 Mark II 是佳能最轻的配备防抖的全画幅相机
zh.summary: 佳能推出了 EOS R8 Mark II，配备机身防抖功能——这是原始 2023 型号所缺少的功能——以及复古设计刷新。该 Mark II 定价 $1,899，将在 10 月晚些时候推出，比原始型号更重，但比 R6 Mark III 更轻且更便宜。

title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argued that AI doesn't require government regulation, positioning artificial intelligence as hardware and software where safety can be engineered by individual product makers. The statement reflects tech industry resistance to external AI oversight.
content: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.

zh.title: 我们不需要人工智能监管 —— 让我们处理安全问题，英伟达的黄仁勋说
zh.summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋主张人工智能不需要政府监管，将人工智能定位为硬件和软件，其中安全可以由各个产品制造商设计。这一声明反映了科技行业对外部人工智能监督的抵触。
